name: io.github.tastytrade/tastytrade-mcp
title: tastytrade
description: Agent access to tastytrade brokerage accounts: quotes, positions, and dry-run-gated order flow.

environmentVariables.name: TASTYTRADE_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: API host. Defaults to the sandbox (cert) environment; set the production host explicitly to trade real money. Only a recognised tastytrade API host is accepted: any other host makes the server refuse to start rather than send the OAuth credentials there, unless that exact hostname is named in TASTYTRADE_ALLOW_UNKNOWN_API_HOST.

environmentVariables.name: TASTYTRADE_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 client id for your tastytrade OAuth application.

environmentVariables.name: TASTYTRADE_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 client secret for your tastytrade OAuth application.

environmentVariables.name: TASTYTRADE_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 refresh token. The server exchanges it for short-lived access tokens and refreshes them automatically.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_ORDER_NOTIONAL_USD
environmentVariables.description: Hard cap on the buying-power impact of a single order. Exceeding it fails the pre-submit sanity check.

environmentVariables.name: TASTYTRADE_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to serve only read-only tools. Write and destructive tools are withheld entirely.

environmentVariables.name: TASTYTRADE_HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request HTTP timeout in milliseconds, applied to every tastytrade call including the token grant. 0 is refused, because the HTTP client reads it as 'wait forever'.

environmentVariables.name: TASTYTRADE_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum size of a response this server will read, applied to every tastytrade call including the token grant. 0 and -1 are refused; the bound cannot be switched off.

environmentVariables.name: TASTYTRADE_HTTP_WALL_CLOCK_MS
environmentVariables.description: Ceiling on the total elapsed time of one request, in milliseconds. Separate from TASTYTRADE_HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS, which is a socket inactivity timeout an upstream can dribble past forever. Must be strictly greater than that value or it is refused. Defaults to three times it.

environmentVariables.name: TASTYTRADE_ACCEPT_VERSION
environmentVariables.description: Override the Accept-Version request header. Defaults to today's UTC date as YYYYMMDD.

environmentVariables.name: TASTYTRADE_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Override the required User-Agent request header. Defaults to <package name>/<version>.

environmentVariables.name: TASTYTRADE_CREDENTIAL_CHANNEL
environmentVariables.description: What the server does about an interposed credential channel: 'warn' (the default, and any unrecognised value) names a proxy or a trust-store override on stderr and in the preflight report and starts anyway; 'strict' refuses to start unless the proxy's hostname is named in TASTYTRADE_ALLOW_PROXY. There is no acknowledgement for a trust-store override (NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS, or SSL_CERT_FILE / SSL_CERT_DIR with --use-openssl-ca): under 'strict' those are always a refusal.

environmentVariables.name: TASTYTRADE_ALLOW_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated proxy HOSTNAMES you acknowledge as carriers of the credential POST. Read only under TASTYTRADE_CREDENTIAL_CHANNEL=strict, where the hostname in http_proxy / https_proxy / all_proxy must appear here or the server refuses to start. Hostnames rather than a boolean, so a config that later retargets the proxy fails closed again.

environmentVariables.name: TASTYTRADE_ALLOW_UNKNOWN_API_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated hostnames acknowledged as destinations for the OAuth refresh token and client secret. The server refuses to start when TASTYTRADE_API_URL names a host that is not a recognised tastytrade API host; naming that exact hostname here allows it, for a proxy, a gateway or a local test double. It does not lift the refusal of plain http: to a non-loopback host, and an acknowledged host still warns on every start.

toolSurface.note: Every destructive tool requires a single-use confirmation token issued by its matching dry_run_* tool, valid for 60 seconds and bound to a hash of the submitted arguments.

install.note: Two supported install paths: clone-and-build, or the published container image. This server is deliberately not published to npm, so there is no npx invocation.

cloneAndBuild.description: Clone the repository, build it, and point your MCP client at the compiled entrypoint.
notes: args must be an absolute path; MCP clients do not resolve ~ or relative paths.
A .env file in the repository is NOT auto-loaded. Credentials must come from the client's env block, or be exported in the launching shell.

docker.description: Run the published image. Credentials come from an --env-file that stays outside the image.
setup: Write a .env holding TASTYTRADE_CLIENT_ID, TASTYTRADE_CLIENT_SECRET and TASTYTRADE_REFRESH_TOKEN, one KEY=value per line. No clone is needed for this path; .env.sample in the repository lists the same names.
notes: The -i flag is mandatory. This is a stdio server: without -i the container exits immediately with no output, which is indistinguishable from a crash.
Do not pass -d/--detach and do not publish a port. There is no HTTP listener.
--env-file keeps credentials out of every image layer and out of the client config file.

rateLimits.scheme: Per-second. These are tastytrade's published request limits, enforced in-process and charged once per tool call.
rateLimits.howItApplies: Every call is charged against the global cap; a call reaching one of the endpoints above is charged against that endpoint's ceiling as well. Tools that are not in the table carry no per-endpoint ceiling, except that the twelve destructive tools are additionally rate-limited by an internal safety cap: a burst of order submissions or cancellations can be refused while the global cap still has room. That cap is a backstop rather than a published budget, so it is not quoted here and a refusal does not name it. Exhaustion returns a rate_limit_exceeded ToolError carrying retry_after_ms.
rateLimits.planningNote: A bucket holds one second of budget, so a 1/sec endpoint permits one call and then a full second of waiting; there is nothing to burst through. Size a polling loop per endpoint rather than per agent, and stream live prices over DXLink instead of polling for them.

notes: The API host defaults to the sandbox. Point TASTYTRADE_API_URL at https://api.tastyworks.com only when you intend to trade real money.
Set TASTYTRADE_READ_ONLY=true to withhold every write and destructive tool.
MAX_ORDER_NOTIONAL_USD caps single-order buying-power impact; the default is 50000.

An unrecognised host in TASTYTRADE_API_URL is a startup refusal rather than a warning: the server exits non-zero rather than POST the refresh token and client secret to a host it does not recognise. TASTYTRADE_ALLOW_UNKNOWN_API_HOST=<hostname> acknowledges one by name, for a proxy or a gateway.
A resources/read is charged the same per-endpoint ceilings as the tool that reaches the same endpoint, plus the global cap at the template's declared fan-out.
